Interactive demo

2×

Tab or arrows to move through fields and controls. Enter or a click copies a field or activates a control. Tap the moving border train to stop or resume it, hold it to speed it up temporarily, and drag it along the border while stopped. Releasing restores its previous speed. Shift+Left or Right sets train speed from 0.5 to 6 times, starting at 2. Space pauses other motion. Page Up or Down scrolls short terminals. Esc pauses the demo.
